primary_outcome: A collected run followed by the correct status and three numeric measurements within 0.01 units (request count exact).
failure_rule: Retain all assignments; missing, malformed, uncollected and provider-failed trials score zero. Stop further paid calls for a model after provider failure or exhausted cost accounting; retain unattempted assignments separately.
scope: One controlled HTTP service, four workload profiles and four pinned model snapshots. The EAL contrast includes executable checking and MCP orchestration; JSON has direct measurement tools but no MCP or EAL evaluator.
